# Gradle Wrapper
Official Gradle 8.13 wrapper scripts and JAR are included.
The distribution checksum is pinned in gradle-wrapper.properties.
The wrapper JAR SHA-256 is 81a82aaea5abcc8ff68b3dfcb58b3c3c429378efd98e7433460610fecd7ae45f.
No global Gradle installation or unchecked bootstrap download is required.
